scenarios.name: Constant sunlight
scenarios.description: 1000 W/m² and 25 °C for 60 s. Isolate startup and steady operation.

scenarios.name: Drop & recovery
scenarios.description: Uniform irradiance drops from 1000 to 250 W/m² at 20 s, then returns at 40 s. Cell temperature stays at 25 °C.

scenarios.name: Changing sunlight
scenarios.description: Irradiance ramps from 300 to 1000 W/m² by 30 s, then falls to 400 W/m² by 60 s.

scenarios.name: Passing clouds
scenarios.description: Three smooth, uniform cloud pulses with different depth and duration. No partial shading.

scenarios.name: Warming cells
scenarios.description: At 1000 W/m², cell temperature rises from 25 to 60 °C between 15 and 45 s.

scenarios.name: Noisy sensors
scenarios.description: Constant 1000 W/m² and 25 °C; independent Gaussian sensor noise σV = 0.12 V, σI = 0.04 A.

seed_policy: Paired sensor normal sequences per scenario and sampling schedule

verification.interpretation: Numerical cross-check of the same model, not physical validation.

convergence.interpretation: Finite refinement sensitivity of harvested energy; no general stability or waveform convergence proof.
